## Overview

Sculk Wrath is a complete Warden boss overhaul datapack that transforms the Warden into a 4-phase boss fight with custom attacks, boss bar, music, configurable drops, and dramatic animations.

## Preview
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/yjOtmVWCa_s" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Installation

### Datapack
1. Copy the `datapack` folder contents into your world's `datapacks` folder
2. Alternatively, place as a zip in the `datapacks` folder
3. Run `/reload` in-game or restart the world

## Configuration

### In-Game Config
Run `/function sculk_wrath:config` to open the interactive configuration menu.
All toggles are clickable and save per-world.

### File-Based Config
Edit `data/sculk_wrath/function/initialize_storage.mcfunction` to change default values.

**⚠️ DO NOT change the `initialized` value** — this is used by the pack to detect first-time setup.

### Available Toggles

| Toggle | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `toggletrophy` | Trophy item dropped on defeat | Enabled |
| `toggledestruction` | Block breaking during attacks | Enabled |
| `togglesonic` | Enhanced Sonic Boom attack | Enabled |
| `togglegroundpound` | Ground Pound AoE attack | Enabled |
| `toggleminions` | Sculk minion spawning | Enabled |
| `togglecharge` | Charge/Dash attack | Enabled |
| `togglesculkstorm` | Sculk Storm in Phase 4 | Enabled |
| `toggledarkness` | Darkness effect pulses | Enabled |
| `toggleanimation` | Special animations and particles | Enabled |
| `togglemusic` | Boss fight music | Enabled |

## Fight Phases

### Phase 1: The Stalker (500 HP)
The Warden awakens. It stalks players with enhanced senses.
- **Sonic Boom**: Charged sonic blast dealing 15 damage
- **Sculk Tendrils**: Ground particles that slow and damage
- **Darkness Pulse**: Periodic darkness effect waves
- Boss bar color: **Blue**

### Phase 2: The Fury (500 HP)
When Phase 1 health reaches 0, the Warden heals and enters Phase 2.
- **Ground Pound**: AoE slam with knockback
- **Sculk Wave**: Line of damage toward players
- **Summon Minions**: Spawns sculk silverfish
- All Phase 1 attacks with increased frequency
- Boss bar color: **Yellow**

### Phase 3: The Rampage (500 HP)
The Warden becomes faster and more aggressive.
- **Charge Attack**: Speed-boosted dash toward players
- **Sculk Eruption**: Area explosion with wither effect
- **Seismic Slam**: Falling blocks and screen shake
- Speed and attack buffs
- Boss bar color: **Red**

### Phase 4: Sculk Storm (500 HP — Final)
The final stand. The Warden unleashes everything.
- **Sculk Storm**: Continuous particle rain with lightning
- **Enraged Roar**: Massive AoE damage + blindness
- **Soul Drain**: Pulls players + wither + warden heals
- Maximum stats, all attacks at highest frequency
- Boss bar color: **Purple**
- **This is the only phase where the Warden can actually die!**

## Total Fight Health: 2000 HP (4 × 500)

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/function sculk_wrath:config` | Open configuration menu |
| `/function sculk_wrath:load` | Reload the datapack |

## Anti-Cheese Mechanics

- **Mace + Density**: Warden gains resistance when hit by mace with Density
- **Burst Damage Protection**: Single hits over 100 damage trigger resistance
- **No Bedrock Trapping**: Works underground naturally
- **Auto-Cleanup**: Pack automatically cleans up on reload

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21+ (Java Edition)
- **Multiplayer**: Fully supported, scales with player count

## Troubleshooting

**Q: The boss bar doesn't appear?**
A: Make sure the warden was naturally spawned (via sculk shrieker). The pack auto-detects wardens.

**Q: The pack broke after a crash?**
A: Simply `/reload` — the pack auto-cleans up on reload. No fix command needed!
